title: Tom Brady drops a hint after a day of tossing dimes

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Tom Brady drops a hint after a day of tossing dimes
sources.description: While it quickly became clear that current and former NFL players can't compete in flag football against experienced high-level flag-football players by simply showing up and playing, one basic fact was abundantly clear during the inaugural Fanatics Flag Football Classic.
